design.abba_rule: odd blocks A B B A; even blocks B A A B (A=b_selected, B=predicted_protect_sham)
design.workload: r2-11-coding-v1 (sha c02f9657...), seed 42, temperature 0, top_k 1, n_predict 512, ctx 4096
design.warmup_rule: NONE. The frozen R3-03B protocol defines a warmup only for the microbenchmark; none is defined for the end-to-end experiment, and the block-count addendum and N=20 addendum count 4 launches per block with no warmups. No warmup is added. Limitation: block 1 launch 1 may be cooler/colder than later launches; the ABBA contrast and the fixed N absorb this only to first order and it is not corrected post hoc.
design.cooldown_rule: 60 s before the first launch of each block (including block 1); 15 s between adjacent launches within a block (R2-12 frozen cooldown semantics as carried by the R3-02 plan); fixed pauses only, no temperature threshold
design.instrumentation: ARGINE_POLICY_TIMING=1 in every launch (P is measured in the same launches as O); ARGINE_RETENTION_TRACE unset (no event trace); graceful Ctrl-C shutdown via the conformance-validated graceful_stop so the policy_timing line is emitted

estimands.O_b: mean over the block's 2 sham launches minus mean over its 2 b_selected launches of wall ms/token
estimands.P_b: same contrast of ns_total/512/1e6 from the policy_timing record (aggregate includes the 2 prefill passes; 512 decoded tokens is the divisor)
estimands.ci: two-sided 95% Fieller interval, t quantile df = N-1 = 19, block-paired means, covariance of means included

classification.REJECTED_UNEXPLAINED: Fieller CI entirely below 0.5 or above 2.0
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: CI bounded but straddles a bound
classification.UNTESTABLE: Fieller set unbounded (g >= 1 or mean P == 0); the protocol's second UNTESTABLE clause (O/P below timer or launch-noise resolution) is not operationalised in code and, if invoked, requires a written analysis note and can never yield EXPLAINED

admission_rule: a launch is admitted only if token digest == ac28efbe..., 512 tokens, graceful shutdown, exactly one valid policy_timing record (calls == 24,672), server timings present, no duplicate-event refusal, no error
failure_rule: a failed launch is retained as FAILED; the same slot may be rerun once (same configuration, same slot); a second failure of the slot aborts the campaign (CAMPAIGN_ABORTED.json) with no imputation, no replacement blocks and no reordering. No optional stopping, no outlier removal, no change of N.
abort_conditions: free RAM feasibility gate (argine.planner.plan, 8 GiB) fails
less than 2 GiB free in the output volume
operator attestation of clean environment absent

retained: per-launch record (tokens, digest, server timings, policy_timing record, wall seconds, shutdown mode, errors)
retention.not_retained: event-level retention traces: not required by the frozen protocol (semantics were proven by the conformance freeze; digest and policy_timing calls==24,672 validate each launch) and writing ~10 GB per launch would slow decode ~4x and contaminate the timing endpoint
retention.expected_disk_bytes_total: <= 10 MB (about 20 KB per launch x 80 plus failed attempts)

output_dir_rule: fresh; the driver refuses an existing directory except with --resume of this same campaign

duration_estimate.basis: conformance logs: model ready ~6 s, prefill 10.3-11.2 s per 187 tokens; decode 512 x 126.16 ms = 64.6 s (R3-02-p4 untraced b_selected step; not observed with this runtime); shutdown planning 20 s (21-39 s observed in traced launches)
duration_estimate.replaces: earlier 3.8 h and N=9 1.7 h point estimates

freeze_method: freeze_sha256 = sha256 of json.dumps(object without freeze_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
